name: 网易云音乐
author: Yggdrasil
description: 通过你自建的 NeteaseCloudMusicApiEnhanced 服务使用网易云：搜索、播放、歌单、歌手、专辑、榜单、评论、MV 与账号。需要你填自己的 API 地址。

fields.label: API 地址
fields.hint: 你自建的 NeteaseCloudMusicApiEnhanced 地址（默认端口 3000）。一行 Docker 就能起：docker run -d -p 3000:3000 moefurina/ncm-api:latest —— 该服务默认允许跨域（CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN=*）。

fields.label: Cookie（可选）
fields.hint: 填了才能用需要登录的接口（每日推荐 / 听歌记录 / 用户歌单 / VIP 与高音质直链）。登录 music.163.com 后从浏览器复制 Cookie 里的 MUSIC_U=... 即可。

endpoints.name: search
endpoints.label: 搜歌
endpoints.description: Search songs by keyword. Returns result.songCount and result.songs[] with id, name, dt (ms), fee (0 free / 1 VIP / 4 paid album / 8 trial), ar[].name + ar[].id (artists), al.name + al.picUrl (album + cover). Take an id to song_url_v1 to get a playable link.
endpoints.emptyHint: songCount is 0: nothing matched. Try a shorter keyword or the artist name, then stop and tell the user what you searched. If code is not 200, the API address or cookie is not set up — check the plugin panel.

endpoints.name: search_album
endpoints.label: 搜专辑
endpoints.description: Search albums. Returns result.albums[] with id, name, picUrl, size (track count), artist.name, publishTime (ms).

endpoints.name: search_artist
endpoints.label: 搜歌手
endpoints.description: Search artists. Returns result.artists[] with id, name, picUrl, albumSize, musicSize. The id feeds artists / artist_top_song / artist_album.

endpoints.name: search_playlist
endpoints.label: 搜歌单
endpoints.description: Search playlists. Returns result.playlists[] with id, name, coverImgUrl, trackCount, playCount, creator.nickname. The id feeds playlist_detail / playlist_track_all.

endpoints.name: search_hot
endpoints.label: 热搜榜
endpoints.description: The current hot search list. Returns result.hots[] with first (keyword) and second (a related term). Useful when the user does not know what to search for.

endpoints.name: search_suggest
endpoints.label: 搜索建议
endpoints.description: Autocomplete / suggestion for a partial keyword. Returns result.allMatch[].keyword plus matching songs, artists, albums and playlists when available.

endpoints.name: song_detail
endpoints.label: 歌曲详情

params.name: ids
params.description: one song id, or several separated by commas (e.g. 186016,347230)

endpoints.description: Full metadata for up to a few hundred songs at once, by id (comma separated). Returns songs[] with name, dt, fee, ar[], al[], publishTime. Use it to refresh what a search returned.

endpoints.name: song_url_v1
endpoints.label: 取播放直链

params.name: level
params.description: standard, higher, exhigh, lossless, hires, jyeffect, sky, jymaster

endpoints.description: The playable audio URL of one song. Put data[0].url into an <audio> element. url is null when the track needs VIP, is region-locked, or the level is above what the account allows.
endpoints.emptyHint: url is null: this track needs a VIP account, is region-locked, or the requested level is too high. Fill the Cookie field in the plugin panel (or lower level to standard) and try once more — then report the limitation instead of retrying.

endpoints.name: lyric
endpoints.label: 取歌词
endpoints.description: Lyrics of a song. lrc.lyric is LRC text with [mm:ss.xx] tags (strip them for a plain panel), tlyric.lyric is the translation (often empty), yrc.lyric is word-by-word (often null).
endpoints.emptyHint: No lyrics in the response: this track has none, or the id is not a song. Show the track without lyrics and say so.

endpoints.name: check_music
endpoints.label: 检查可播放性
endpoints.description: Whether a song is playable for this account. Returns success (true/false) and message. Check it when a url comes back null and you want to distinguish "no rights" from "wrong id".

endpoints.name: simi_song
endpoints.label: 相似歌曲
endpoints.description: Similar songs to a given one. Returns songs[] with id, name, artists[].name, album.name. Good for "play something like this".

endpoints.name: album
endpoints.label: 专辑详情
endpoints.description: One album: album.name / picUrl / publishTime / size / company / artists[], plus the full songs[] track list.

endpoints.name: album_new
endpoints.label: 新碟上架

params.name: area
params.description: region: ALL, ZH, EA, KR, JP

endpoints.description: Newly released albums. Returns albums[] with id, name, picUrl, artist.name, publishTime.

endpoints.name: artists
endpoints.label: 歌手详情
endpoints.description: One artist: artist.name / picUrl / albumSize / musicSize / briefDesc, plus hotSongs[] (their top tracks).

endpoints.name: artist_top_song
endpoints.label: 歌手热门歌
endpoints.description: An artist top 50 songs. Returns songs[] in the same shape as search. Use it for "more songs by this artist".

endpoints.name: artist_album
endpoints.label: 歌手专辑
endpoints.description: Albums of one artist. Returns hotAlbums[] with id, name, picUrl, publishTime, size.

endpoints.name: artist_songs
endpoints.label: 歌手全部歌曲
endpoints.description: Songs by an artist with paging (order=hot or time). Returns songs[]. Use it when top 50 is not enough.

endpoints.name: simi_artist
endpoints.label: 相似歌手
endpoints.description: Artists similar to a given one. Returns artists[] with id, name, picUrl.

endpoints.name: artist_list
endpoints.label: 歌手分类列表

params.name: type
params.description: genre code: -1 all, 1 male, 2 female, 3 band

params.name: initial
params.description: first letter a-z, or empty for hot

endpoints.description: Browse artists by region / genre / initial letter. Returns artists[] with id, name, picUrl, albumSize.

endpoints.name: playlist_detail
endpoints.label: 歌单详情
endpoints.description: One playlist: playlist.name / coverImgUrl / trackCount / playCount / description / creator.nickname, plus **the full tracks[]** (the server asks for up to 100000). Use playlist_track_all only when you want a page of a very large playlist.

endpoints.name: playlist_track_all
endpoints.label: 歌单全部歌曲
endpoints.description: Every song in a playlist, with paging. Returns songs[]. This is how you turn "play this playlist" into concrete song ids.

endpoints.name: top_playlist
endpoints.label: 排行榜歌单

params.name: cat
params.description: category name, e.g. 华语 / 欧美 / 古风 / 电子; use playlist_catlist to see them

endpoints.description: The playlist leaderboard, filterable by category and sorted by hot or new. Returns playlists[].

endpoints.name: playlist_catlist
endpoints.label: 歌单分类
endpoints.description: All playlist categories: sub[] (name + categories) and categories (the top-level grouping). Use it to pick a valid cat for top_playlist.

endpoints.name: personalized
endpoints.label: 推荐歌单
endpoints.description: Personalized (recommended) playlists. Returns result[] with id, name, picUrl, playCount, trackCount.

endpoints.name: toplist
endpoints.label: 排行榜列表
endpoints.description: The official charts (飙升榜, 新歌榜, 热歌榜…). Returns list[] with id, name, coverImgUrl, updateFrequency. A list id can be passed to playlist_detail.

endpoints.name: recommend_songs
endpoints.label: 每日推荐
endpoints.description: The daily recommended songs for the logged-in account (needs a cookie). Returns data.dailySongs[] with the usual song fields.
endpoints.emptyHint: Empty or code not 200: this endpoint needs a logged-in cookie. Tell the user to fill the Cookie field in the plugin panel.

endpoints.name: personalized_newsong
endpoints.label: 推荐新歌
endpoints.description: Recommended new songs. Returns result[] with id, name, picUrl and a nested song object (the playable id is result[].song.id).

endpoints.name: record_recent_song
endpoints.label: 听歌记录
endpoints.description: Recently played songs of the logged-in account (needs a cookie). Returns data.list[] where the song is under .data (id, name, ar[].name) and .playCount is how often it was played.

endpoints.name: comment_music
endpoints.label: 歌曲评论
endpoints.description: Comments on a song: hotComments[] (the highlighted ones) and comments[] (by time), each with user.nickname, content, likedCount, time (ms).

endpoints.name: comment_playlist
endpoints.label: 歌单评论
endpoints.description: Comments on a playlist. Same shape as comment_music.

endpoints.name: mv_url
endpoints.label: MV 地址

params.name: id
params.description: mv id (from a song or a search)

endpoints.description: The playable video URL of an MV. Returns data.url — put it in a <video controls> element.

endpoints.name: mv_detail
endpoints.label: MV 详情
endpoints.description: One MV: data.name / artistName / cover / playCount / duration / desc.

endpoints.name: login_status
endpoints.label: 登录状态
endpoints.description: Whether the cookie in the plugin panel is logged in, and who it is. Call it first when something that needs an account returns empty.

endpoints.name: user_detail
endpoints.label: 用户详情

params.name: uid
params.description: user id (from login_status or a playlist creator)

endpoints.description: A user profile: nickname, userId, avatarUrl, follows, followeds, playlistCount, level.

endpoints.name: user_playlist
endpoints.label: 用户歌单
endpoints.description: Playlists owned or collected by a user. Returns playlist[] with id, name, coverImgUrl, trackCount, playCount.

endpoints.name: user_record
endpoints.label: 用户听歌排行
endpoints.description: A user listening ranking: weekData[] (last week) or allData[] (all time) — each has playCount and song (id, name, ar[].name).
